methodologyNotes: Prices fetched June 2026 via WebFetch from official vendor pages and reputable review/comparison sites. Official vendor pages (rosettastone.com/buy confirmed via direct fetch — $19.99/mo, $159/yr) are treated as primary sources. Duolingo's pricing pages are JS-only; prices corroborated against multiple 2026 comparison sources (dealnews.com May 2026, duoplanet.com) — Super annual $6.99/mo, Max $29.99/mo monthly and $168/yr ($14/mo) annual. Babbel consumer per-month single-language website prices ($9.95/$8.45/$6.95) confirmed by two independent 2026 sources (fluentin3months.com and edureviewer.com). ADVERSARIAL VERIFICATION (2026-06-14): Original Busuu figures (Premium $13.95/mo, $83.40/yr; Premium Plus $139.99/yr) could NOT be confirmed against current 2026 sources — multiple 2026 reviews (testprepinsight.com, talkreal.org) indicate Busuu has consolidated Premium/Premium Plus into a single Premium plan with annual ~$62.99/yr ($5.25/mo) and monthly ~$10.50, contradicting the stale FluentU/App Store figures; per verification policy all unconfirmable Busuu paid monthlyUsd values set to null. Original Memrise figures ($22.99/mo, $71.99/yr, $100 lifetime) could NOT be confirmed — 2026 sources cite monthly $14.99–$24.99, annual $61.99 (not $71.99), and lifetime $329.99 ($100 is a promo coupon, not standing price); unconfirmable Memrise paid monthlyUsd values set to null. Pimsleur corrected: independent 2026 sources (myelearningworld.com) confirm Premium single-language = $19.95/mo (was mislabeled $20.95) and All Access = $20.95/mo (was null but is in fact confirmable). annualDiscountPct computed only where both monthly and annual prices are confirmed. All telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null as these are non-telephony products.
